name: Kabal AS
note: Norwegian logistics-software (SaaS) company for oil and gas, headquartered at Skansegata 2, Stavanger (Brønnøysund orgnr 996 787 303, private aksjeselskap, founded 2011, sector 2100). Founded by Jan Inge Pedersen and Fredrik Larsen; its website says it is backed by investor Insight Partners. No full owner chain stated by its sources.
